title: Canonical cohomology map for a topological f-map

from.place: Proof: the canonical cohomology maps used in continuity of the punctured-neighborhood inverse system.

statement: Let h:X→Y be a continuous map of topological spaces, A an abelian sheaf on Y, B an abelian sheaf on X, α:A→h_*B an f-map, and c a family of maps H^q(V,A)→H^q(h⁻¹V,h⁻¹A) on object cohomology [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback-data, def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Define m(h,c,α,q):H^q(Y,A)→H^q(X,B) as c at V=Y followed by the cohomology map of the adjoint h⁻¹A→B [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], and finally by restriction along the equality h⁻¹(Y)=X. This is precisely the pre-existing spectralLimitCohomologyMap definition, relocated without changing its expression.
